messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: New release: simmer 3.7.0
parts:
Hi all,

A new release of simmer arrived at CRAN this past weekend (see [1])
with several bug fixes and new features, such as the
timeout_from_attribute() activity. Now, instead of

trajectory() %>%
set_attribute("delay", 1) %>%
# ...
timeout(function() get_attribute(env, "delay"))

you can write

trajectory() %>%
set_attribute("delay", 1) %>%
# ...
timeout_from_attribute("delay")

which is more convenient and faster. Also, setters such as
set_attribute, set_capacity, set_prioritization... include a new
argument called "mod", which allows us to modify the
attribute/capacity/whatever instead of providing a new value. For
example, instead of

trajectory() %>%
set_attribute("delay", 1) %>%
# ...
set_attribute("delay", function() get_attribute(env, "delay") + 1)

you can write the much shorter and legible

trajectory() %>%
set_attribute("delay", 1) %>%
# ...
set_attribute("delay", 1, mod="+")

Regards,
Iñaki

[1] https://www.enchufa2.es/archives/simmer-3-7-0.html
